profile.headline: Software Engineer 3 at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Dennis. I'm a Software Engineer who enjoys tinkering, building tools, and turning ideas into reliable systems.

I currently lead teams developing scalable, cloud-native web applications. My work spans full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, and deployment automation. I enjoy building reliable systems and creating tools that make other engineers more productive. I've worked across a range of environments, from independent projects to larger engineering teams, collaborating directly with clients to turn requirements into reliable software.

In my free time, I enjoy distance running, reading fantasy, and making music with my modular synthesizer. I'm also a fan of terminals, Neovim, and NixOS.

I'm always happy to connect with people building interesting things.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Lead the successful development and deployment of multiple full-stack web applications using Go (Golang), Python, and JavaScript with React.js, providing a fast and intuitive user experience.

Build distributed systems that are highly scalable and reliable, leveraging AWS and Docker to ensure efficient delivery of business-critical data.

Communicate effectively with clients to gather requirements and feedback, adapting project deliverables and technical sprints to meet changing needs and ensure client satisfaction.

Implement and optimize Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines to streamline software testing and deployment processes, reducing development time by 25% and improving overall project efficiency.

Work with a variety of RDBMS (Relational Database Management Systems) including PostgreSQL, H2, SQLite, and Oracle to store and retrieve data for web applications, ensuring high data integrity and security.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Skills: Technical Architecture · Full-Stack Development · Communication · Mentoring · Distributed Systems · Web Development · SQL · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Computer Science · Docker · Python (Programming Language) · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: NIH IT & AV Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led and training a six-person team to provide award-winning technical support. Mentored and motivated team members to achieve project goals and objectives.

Coordinated with stakeholders of varying backgrounds, including NIH personnel, public figures, scientists, and researchers, to identify technical requirements and ensure successful project delivery.

Maintained operational excellence in high-stake environments by ensuring adherence to established policies, processes, and standards. Identified and mitigated risks that could impact project delivery.

Tested and repaired audio visual and IT systems routinely to ensure optimal performance for events. Diagnosed problems promptly and implemented solutions that minimize downtime and disruption to events.
positions.insights: Skills: System Administration · Leadership · Team Coordination · Client Relations · Training

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.locationName: Ocean City, Maryland, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Enabled the organization to optimize costs and achieve financial objectives for the annual Ocean City Film Festival by generating detailed cost analysis reports using Jupyter and providing critical financial insights that informed key business decisions.

Increased data collection efficiency and accuracy by designing and developing a reusable software CLI tool that automated a complex three-month process in just two weeks.

Built a Selenium web scraper that saved 40+ hours of business intelligence research, collecting and analyzing large volumes of data from multiple sources, providing actionable intelligence that informed critical business decisions.

Streamlined ad management processes, managing and distributing sponsored ads with a reusable data pipeline developed with Python and Pandas.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Data Visualization · Automation · Business Intelligence (BI) · Web Scraping

positions.title: Audio Visual Specialist
positions.description:
Delivered robust and reliable systems by designing and implementing customized audio-visual systems for permanent and temporary installations, utilizing a deep understanding of technical requirements and user needs.

Resolved issues efficiently, demonstrating exceptional problem-solving skills by systematically troubleshooting technical issues in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

positions.title: Live Sound Engineer
positions.description:
Mixed live sound for diverse events and musical performances, utilizing knowledge of audio signal processing, mixing techniques, and equipment operation.

Maintained and repaired audio equipment, developing in-depth knowledge of audio equipment technology and troubleshooting skills.

Utilized audio editing software, such as Pro Tools and Logic Pro, to refine audio recordings of live performances for post-production and distribution.

Collaborated with music producers and sound designers, utilizing excellent communication and teamwork skills to achieve artistic and technical goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Audio Engineering · Event Management

positions.title: Technical Operations - Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
Directed and mentored teams of 2-5 student technicians, providing technical guidance to ensure seamless execution of university events.

Ensured smooth operations and excellent customer service for a variety of events, collaborating closely with event managers, student groups, and university administration.

Utilized project management software to streamline team workflows and ensure timely completion of tasks.

Developed and maintained technical documentation and training materials to facilitate knowledge transfer among team members and ensure consistent quality of service.
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · Communication · Leadership · Event Management · Training

projects.title: Full-Stack Dashboard Web Application
projects.description:
• Created and deployed an application to track and visualize Maryland vaccines using public data
• Scheduled ETL batch processes to automate updating data daily via HTTP requests and webhooks
• Isolated web and scheduler processes into separate Docker containers for portability in production
• Built reusable custom classes to create an abstracted, high-level API for development
• Configured and deployed the app on Heroku

projects.title: Discogs Command Line Utility
projects.description:
• Produced an application to parse, read, and write custom spreadsheets using Python generators
• Retrieved item listing URLs programmatically with the Discogs REST API
